"""Every number and every open ruling in Playmaker lives here.

Numbers come straight from the rulebook, the trackers and the scenario rules.
Settings marked OQ-n match the numbered items in OPEN_QUESTIONS.md: each default
is the one the designer asked for, and a ruling is a one-line change here.
"""
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Rules:
    # OQ-1: ball after an intercept or steal that plays on.
    #   'play_on' : ball back to the passer / stays with the carrier, -5, play continues.
    #   'end'     : the possession ends at that point.
    turnover_play_on: str = 'play_on'
    # OQ-2: when a pass resolves.
    #   'defence_turn' : on the defence's next turn (it may Intercept); if it doesn't,
    #                    the pass completes at the start of that turn.
    #   'immediate'    : completes at once unless a defender is already on the line.
    pass_resolution: str = 'defence_turn'
    # OQ-3: Sprint length = Move length + Quick Step, in one straight line.
    sprint_orth_base: int = MOVE_STRAIGHT
    sprint_diag_base: int = MOVE_DIAGONAL
    # OQ-4: roll bounds. A target >= 20 always succeeds, <= 0 always fails.
    natural_rolls: bool = False
    # OQ-5 (ruled): a declared shot worth less than 0 scores 0, matching the forced shot.
    floor_declared_shot: bool = True
    # OQ-6: defence reaction to a declared shot may use 0, 1 or 2 actions (movement, arrow
    #   turns, Steal) from the tokens still in the pool.
    reaction_kinds: tuple = ('move', 'qs', 'sprint', 'steal')
    reaction_may_decline: bool = True
    # OQ-7: defence out of tokens ends the phase at once (as written).
    defence_empty_ends_phase: bool = True
    # OQ-8: a wait (Hesitate / Pause) may not be played on the turn straight after the
    #   other side's wait.
    wait_chain_block: bool = True
    # OQ-9: screen geometry.
    #   'from_t_or_corner' : a defender's diagonal step is banned if it starts on the T
    #                        square or cuts the T square's corner (T is one of the two
    #                        squares the diagonal passes between).
    #   'from_t_only'      : only diagonal steps that start on the T square are banned.
    screen_geometry: str = 'from_t_or_corner'
    # OQ-29 (RULED, step 3i follow-up): how long a screen lasts and when it can be set.
    #   'hold_until_move' : a Screen is the turn's first action, or its second straight after that same
    #                       player's Move; it ends the turn and lasts until the screener moves (he may Move at
    #                       any time), a Challenge beats it (removed for every defender) or the phase ends.
    #   'two_turns'       : the old engine: any time in the turn; the screener can't move; it flips back after
    #                       the offence's next turn and survives the phase reset; a beaten Challenge lets that
    #                       one defender through.
    screen_rule: str = 'hold_until_move'
    # OQ-10: arrow line. A ball carrier move is illegal only if its path goes from one
    #   side of the ray to the other (touching or stepping onto the line is fine).
    arrow_line_strict: bool = True
    # Drives (RULED, step 3i follow-up). 'zone': the ball carrier may enter a square in the zone of a defender
    #   adjacent to him at the start of the movement, but no square of the path before the destination may
    #   lie in it, unless he beat that defender with a Dribble this phase. 'arrow_line': the old rule (the
    #   path may not cross the defender's arrow line).
    drive_rule: str = 'zone'
    # Intercept outcome (RULED, step 3i follow-up). True: an Intercept that wins (-5, the ball stays with the
    #   passer) puts the interceptor back on the square and arrow he had at the start of the defence's turn
    #   (his Move stays used); one that misses leaves him where he moved, on the pass line. False: the old
    #   engine (he stays on the pass line either way).
    intercept_return: bool = True
    # Interception (RULED, the OQ-72 refinement). 'move_then_intercept':
    #   the pass line is fixed from passer to receiver once the pass is declared;
    #   one defender answers in the defence's turn: (a) one Move, Quick Step or Sprint from his starting square,
    #   straight along one of his arrow lines, whose path crosses or ends on the pass line, ending on the
    #   pass-line square it meets (the corner-slip fix: a diagonal pass can't slip between corner-touching
    #   squares), a Sprint keeping his facing; then the Intercept (the defence's whole turn); or (b) through
    #   you: the line passes through his square, and the Intercept is his first action, whatever his facing;
    #   anything else first and the pass completes before that action: no other defender's action creates
    #   or opens an Intercept;
    #   the passer's ring: no Intercept on any square next to the passer (a defender there Steals instead).
    #   A failed Intercept (the pass completes) leaves him on the pass line with his Move used. What a
    #   successful one costs is turnover_cost.
    # 'ring_jump': the first OQ-72 ruling (the Intercept is itself a straight Move or Quick Step, a defender
    #   may follow first, success ends the possession). 'approach': the rule before OQ-72. Both kept so old
    #   logs replay.
    intercept_rule: str = 'move_then_intercept'
    # What a successful Intercept or Steal costs the offence (RULED, play-on; intercepts and steals alike).
    #   'minus5_lose_phase' : -5 and the shot clock loses one phase (2 seconds); the current phase goes on
    #                         with the same tokens and actions left; in the final phase the possession ends
    #                         and scores 0. The ball stays with the passer (an Intercept) or the carrier (a
    #                         Steal); a Steal on a declared shot cancels the shot (it doesn't use the phase's
    #                         shot) and play goes on.
    #   'minus5' | 'minus10' : the points only, play on.   'lose_phase' : the clock only (no points).
    #   'end_possession'     : the possession ends at -5.
    #   'legacy'             : the engine before this ruling (an Intercept as its intercept_rule says; a Steal
    #                          in play -5 and play on, on a declared shot the possession ends at -5).
    #   The old name intercept_cost is an alias (with_rules accepts it; Rules.intercept_cost reads it).
    turnover_cost: str = 'minus5_lose_phase'
    # OQ-11: a 1 straight + 1 diagonal Move may go in either order.
    move_either_order: bool = True
    # OQ-12 (ruled: the defence chooses any adjacent defender): contest choice.
    #   'min_value' : defence picks the adjacent defender (or none) that minimises the
    #                 expected shot value, counting foul free throws.
    #   'nearest'   : the nearest adjacent defender (rulebook wording), ties by min value.
    #   'player'    : (RULED, step 3b) the defence chooses: contest with any adjacent defender, or not.
    contest_choice: str = 'player'
    # ---- new questions found while building (OPEN_QUESTIONS.md 13+) ----
    # OQ-13 (RULED by the rulebook, Nov 2026): "Through you: the line passes through your square's centre."
    #   0 = the pass line passes exactly through the square's centre (as check_scenarios.py does; rows,
    #   columns, diagonals and the rational lines between); 0.5 was the engine's earlier reading (the line
    #   through the middle half of the square). Only 'through you' uses it under move_then_intercept: a lane
    #   jump is geometry (lane_meet).
    on_line_tolerance: float = 0
    # OQ-76 (RULED by the rulebook, Nov 2026): "Jump the lane: one straight Move, Quick Step or Sprint along your
    #   arrow, keeping your facing." True: the Move half of move-then-intercept keeps the defender's arrow (a
    #   Sprint always did, a Quick Step never turns). False: the engine before the ruling (the Move could turn).
    lane_jump_keeps_facing: bool = True
    # Receiver denial (RULED by the designer, Nov 2026): a pass may not travel through the square of a defender next
    #   to the receiver: the lane is blocked, not interceptable, whatever his facing. "Through" is the pass line within
    #   receiver_denial_tol of the defender's centre (half a square), strictly between passer and receiver. Defenders
    #   elsewhere on the line are unchanged (through-you intercept, the roll as normal). False: no denial.
    receiver_denial: bool = True
    receiver_denial_tol: float = 0.5
    # OQ-14: Quick Step may be shorter than the card value (up to 2, not exactly 2).
    qs_up_to: bool = True
    # OQ-15: a player with Quick Step 0 cannot Sprint.
    sprint_needs_qs: bool = True
    # OQ-52 (RULED): each player has one Quick Step a phase, and a Sprint uses it ("uses that player's
    #   Move and Quick Step", trackers). So no Sprint after that player's Quick Step, no Quick Step after
    #   their Sprint, no second Quick Step. The side's limit of 2 Quick Steps (Sprints count) still applies.
    qs_once_per_player: bool = True
    # A defender's arrow (RULED: back to the single arrow after the move-then-intercept run, where the single
    #   arrow with late closeout off was the cell closest to basketball; the wedge is kept available).
    #   'single' : one arrow line.
    #   'wedge'  : two arrow lines 45 degrees apart (directions a and a+1 for arrow index a): passes,
    #              drives, steals and contest facing test either line; a Sprint sets one edge to the run
    #              direction and the defender picks the side of the other.
    arrow_mode: str = 'single'
    # Step 3h (rule test, not adopted): contest quality.
    #   'current'      : any adjacent defender contests; arrow off the shooter = a foul roll; -3 when the
    #                    contester is further from the rim than the shooter.
    #   'wedge_mirror' : facing gates the contest (shooter on an arrow line); Front if the rim square
    #                    lies in the wedge mirrored backwards, Behind if it lies in the forward wedge,
    #                    else Side (needs arrow_mode 'wedge').
    #   'rim_distance' : facing gates the contest; Front if closer to the rim than the shooter, Side if
    #                    level, Behind if further.
    #   Front: full contest. Side: a foul roll (Foul contest rating). Behind: a foul roll and the -3.
    contest_geometry: str = 'current'
    # OQ-63 (RULED, step 3i): the ball carrier can't Screen (a handoff is a short pass, not a screen).
    carrier_can_screen: bool = False
    # Step 3i (rule test, not adopted): a contester who used a reaction movement (Move, Sprint or Quick
    #   Step) to reach the contest is late: at the rim, post or floater a foul roll; on a mid-range, long
    #   two or three the -3 and no foul roll. One who was already adjacent (and only turns) contests as now.
    late_closeout: bool = False
    # OQ-16 (ruled): who may Challenge a screen.
    #   'on_t'     : only the defender standing on the screen's T square (the one it blocks).
    #   'adjacent' : any defender next to the screener.   'any' : any defender.
    challenge_who: str = 'on_t'
    # OQ-17 (ruled): a locked ball carrier may not Dribble: a lost dribble means pass or shoot.
    locked_can_dribble: bool = False
    # OQ-18: a Dribble win frees the carrier from that defender's arrow line for the rest
    #   of the phase.
    dribble_win_lasts: str = 'phase'
    # OQ-19: before the inbound pass lands the inbounder may only Pass.
    inbounder_pass_only: bool = True
    # OQ-20 (ruled): the far-contest -3 never takes a contest below 0.
    floor_contest_zero: bool = True
    # OQ-21: a side with tokens but no legal action forfeits its remaining tokens.
    forfeit_when_stuck: bool = True
    # OQ-22: Need a Three: a two-point shot (and its free throws) scores 0.
    three_only_ft_on_twos: bool = False
    # OQ-23: Coach's Call bonus uses the band of the look (shot value, or free throws if fouled)
    #   and also applies to a forced shot by the target.
    coach_bonus_on_forced: bool = True
    # OQ-24: the arrow-line restriction applies to defenders adjacent at the start of the
    #   movement action.
    arrow_line_adjacent_at: str = 'start'
    # OQ-25: two diagonal steps of a Move go the same way (a straight diagonal line).
    diag_move_straight: bool = True
    # OQ-27 (ruled): on a failed inbound, a tie for "furthest from the rim" is the offence's
    #   choice ('offence'); 'lowest' gives the ball to the lowest piece number.
    inbound_tie: str = 'offence'
    # OQ-30 (RULED, step 3b): the forced shot's type at clock 0. 'player' = the offence picks among the
    #   types its zone allows; 'best' = the engine picks the best expected value.
    forced_shot_choice: str = 'player'
    # OQ-35 (ruled): an inbound pass works like any other pass. The defence gets its normal
    #   turn (1 or 2 actions: e.g. Move then Intercept, Sprint then Intercept, or move two
    #   players); the pass resolves after that turn, then the phase resets to the card's clock.
    #   'after_defence_turn' (ruled) | 'defence_turn_start' (step 1: lands at the start of the turn)
    inbound_resolves: str = 'after_defence_turn'
    # OQ-34 (new rule, the and-one): once a shot is declared (or forced at clock 0), any foul
    #   scores the higher of the free throws and the shot's uncontested value. Fouling a good
    #   look can then never help the defence. False = free throws only.
    and_one: bool = True
    # Step 3m Part A: the digital match format. A turnover (a successful Intercept, a successful Steal, including on
    #   a declared shot, and shot-clock expiry) ends the possession and it scores 0. Steal fouls are unchanged.
    #   False = the printed (tabletop) rules.
    digital: bool = False
    # Step 3n designer rulings (shared by both formats unless marked):
    # F1: a failed Steal (no foul, the ball kept) locks the defender for the rest of the phase, as a failed Challenge
    #   locks the challenger (no Move or Sprint; his Quick Step is left).
    steal_lock: bool = True
    # F2: the angle of a reach decides the foul risk. A Steal, or a contest that needs a foul roll, makes one foul roll
    #   if the defender is closer to the rim than the ball carrier (or shooter), two if level or further (either fouls).
    #   The contest -3 for further from the rim is unchanged.
    reach_angle_fouls: bool = True
    # F3 (digital only): team fouls run across a quarter of this many possessions per side; from the bonus_from-th
    #   team foul a steal foul gives free throws and ends the possession. Tabletop keeps its within-possession rule
    #   (first steal foul +5, second free throws).
    quarter_possessions: int = 18
    bonus_from: int = 5
    # Shaun's rulings of 9 Nov 2026 (DECISIONS.md), shared by both formats:
    # D-18: Contest is an action. After a shot is declared the defence reacts with up to 2 actions from its remaining
    #   tokens (Move, Quick Step, Sprint, Steal or Contest). A Contest is the last action, one a phase, by one defender
    #   next to the shooter at that moment, and uses a token; no Contest means a contest of 0. A forced shot at clock 0
    #   (not declared) keeps the contest choice. False: the free contest after the reaction (before the ruling).
    contest_action: bool = True
    # D-82: a turnover that scores the possession 0 scores 0 or the total banked before it, whichever is lower.
    #   False: it scores 0.
    turnover_floor: bool = True
    # D-151, D-153, D-154 (Shaun, 11 Nov 2026): the control rule, the app's rule at size 2; the table's rules stay
    #   without it (on hold, D-146). Control against reaction. A player whose last movement this phase was a Quick Step
    #   or a Sprint is rushed; a Move, or no movement this phase, is set (a Move after a Quick Step or Sprint restores
    #   control). A rushed shot has a reduced rating. A rushed Contest has a reduced rating, and today's foul rolls for
    #   its position with no extra roll for being rushed (D-154). No exceptions: the forced shot and its free Contest
    #   follow the same test.
    #   'app' (the default: size 2 in the app's format, off at the table) | '0' (off; 'off' is the same) | '1' | '2' |
    #   '3': the reduction in rating steps, the same for every shot type and for the Contest. control_size(rules) is
    #   the size in play.
    control: str = 'app'
    # Step 18g (D-167, Shaun, 12 Nov 2026; the app only, under test): the zone of influence. 'on': each defender
    #   carries two equal arrows 45 degrees apart (directions a and a+1 for arrow index a), each under the normal
    #   arrow rules. A ball handler or shooter on either counts as "the arrow on him" (a Steal, a Contest); an
    #   Intercept goes along either. The wedge between them, out to the squares one movement still left to him
    #   reaches, is his zone: an adjacent ball handler may end in it but not pass through it. A Dribble won against
    #   him breaks it for the rest of the phase: no arrow at all (no Steal, a Contest with the wrong-angle foul roll,
    #   an Intercept only through his own square), and his movement is locked as today. 'off': today's rules.
    zone: str = 'off'
    # Step 18i (Shaun, 13 Nov 2026): FIBA rules for single possessions, the app only. Each: 'app' (on in the app's
    # format, off at the table, as control), 'on' or 'off'. On in the app since their checks passed (step 18i).
    #   three_seconds (D-172, FIBA Article 26): an attacker in the key at two phase ends in a row: a turnover.
    #   closely_guarded (D-173, Article 27): a ball handler holding the ball, closely guarded at three phase ends in a
    #     row: a turnover. After dribbling, two full phases with no action by him and he has picked the ball up: he
    #     may only pass or shoot, and the count runs.
    #   fiba_fouled_shot (D-174, Articles 34 and 38): a fouled shot scores the contested shot plus the free throws the
    #     rules give (1 if it went in, 2 or 3 if it missed), each at the shooter's free-throw rating: the expected value.
    three_seconds: str = 'app'
    # Step 18j (Shaun, 13 Nov 2026), the app only, as the three above ('app', 'on' or 'off'):
    #   soft_contest (D-177): next to the shooter is a soft contest (the contest rating less 3, no action, never a
    #     foul); a Contest action is a hard contest (the full rating); from the side or behind a hard contest rolls
    #     twice for a foul even with the arrow on him, as a Steal does.
    #   fiba_steal_foul (D-179): a steal foul outside the penalty gives no +5: a team foul, the defender locked, play
    #     on. In the penalty, two free throws, as before.
    soft_contest: str = 'app'
    fiba_steal_foul: str = 'app'
    closely_guarded: str = 'app'
    fiba_fouled_shot: str = 'app'
    # D-89: every steal foul is +5 to the offence; in the bonus it also gives free throws and the possession ends.
    #   False: in the bonus the foul gives free throws only (no +5).
    steal_foul_always_plus5: bool = True

    @property
    def intercept_cost(self):
        return self.turnover_cost


# The step 3i follow-up rulings (screens, the wedge, drives through a zone, the interceptor's return): a log
# records these settings in its setup line; a log from before them replays with the old values.
RULED_3I = ('arrow_mode', 'screen_rule', 'drive_rule', 'intercept_return', 'late_closeout', 'intercept_rule',
            'turnover_cost', 'on_line_tolerance', 'lane_jump_keeps_facing', 'receiver_denial', 'receiver_denial_tol',
            'steal_lock', 'reach_angle_fouls', 'quarter_possessions', 'bonus_from', 'contest_action', 'turnover_floor',
            'steal_foul_always_plus5')
# A log from before Shaun's rulings of 9 Nov 2026 (no contest_action in its setup line) replays without them.
PRE_9NOV = dict(contest_action=False, turnover_floor=False, steal_foul_always_plus5=False)
# A log from before the step 3n rulings replays without them (nor the later ones).
PRE_3N = dict(steal_lock=False, reach_angle_fouls=False, **PRE_9NOV)
LEGACY_3I = dict(arrow_mode='single', screen_rule='two_turns', drive_rule='arrow_line', intercept_return=False,
                 intercept_rule='approach', turnover_cost='legacy', on_line_tolerance=0.5, lane_jump_keeps_facing=False,
                 receiver_denial=False)
# A log from before the rulebook revision of Nov 2026 (no on_line_tolerance / lane_jump_keeps_facing in its setup
# line) replays with the readings it was played under.
PRE_RULEBOOK = dict(on_line_tolerance=0.5, lane_jump_keeps_facing=False, receiver_denial=False)
# A log from before the receiver-denial ruling replays without it (a log recording the rulebook readings but not it).
PRE_DENIAL = dict(receiver_denial=False)
TURNOVER_COSTS = ('minus5_lose_phase', 'minus5', 'minus10', 'lose_phase', 'end_possession', 'legacy')
INTERCEPT_RULES = ('move_then_intercept', 'ring_jump', 'approach')

# D-151: the control rule's sizes, in rating steps: one size, for every shot type and for the Contest alike
CONTROL = {'off': 0, '0': 0, '1': 1, '2': 2, '3': 3}
CONTROL_APP = 2                      # D-153: the app's size
RUSH_QS, RUSH_SPRINT = 1, 2          # what left a player rushed (two bits a player in GameState.rush_o / rush_x)


# D-172: the key, as the lines are drawn on the board: columns G to K, from the baseline row to the free-throw line
KEY_COLS, KEY_ROWS = (6, 10), (1, 6)
SOFT_CONTEST = 3                    # D-177: a soft contest is the contest rating less this
# D-171: time is counted in phase ends: two in a row are about 3 seconds, three about 5
THREE_SECOND_ENDS, GUARDED_ENDS, PICKUP_IDLE_PHASES = 2, 3, 2


def app_rule(rules, name):
    """A step 18i rule's setting: 'app' is on in the app's format and off at the table; 'on'; 'off'."""
    v = getattr(rules, name)
    return rules.digital if v == 'app' else v == 'on'


def control_size(rules):
    """The control rule's size in play, in rating steps (0: the rule is off): the app's format plays size 2 by
    default (D-153), the table's rules none (D-146)."""
    if rules.control == 'app':
        return CONTROL_APP if rules.digital else 0
    return CONTROL[rules.control]


def control_cut(rules, shot_type=None):
    """The reduction a rushed shot, or a rushed Contest of it, takes under rules.control (0 when the rule is off)."""
    return control_size(rules)


DEFAULT_RULES = Rules()


def with_rules(**changes):
    """A copy of the default rules with some settings changed (intercept_cost is the old name of
    turnover_cost)."""
    if 'intercept_cost' in changes:
        changes = dict(changes)
        changes['turnover_cost'] = changes.pop('intercept_cost')
    return replace(DEFAULT_RULES, **changes)

"""Load the player cards, teams and scenario cards from the provided data files."""
import os
import sys
import types

DATA_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), 'data')


def _load(name, extra=None):
    path = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, name + '.py')
    mod = types.ModuleType('playmaker_data_' + name)
    mod.__file__ = path
    saved = {}
    for k, v in (extra or {}).items():       # satisfy plain 'from teams import TEAMS'
        saved[k] = sys.modules.get(k)
        sys.modules[k] = v
    try:
        with open(path) as f:
            exec(compile(f.read(), path, 'exec'), mod.__dict__)
    finally:
        for k, v in saved.items():
            if v is None:
                sys.modules.pop(k, None)
            else:
                sys.modules[k] = v
    return mod


DATA = _load('data')
TEAMS_MOD = _load('teams')
SCEN_MOD = _load('scenarios', {'teams': TEAMS_MOD})

OFF, DEF = DATA.OFF, DATA.DEF


class Card:
    # num: the card's printed position (1 PG .. 5 C). slot: the slot it fills on its team (it sets the piece: O4 is
    # slot 4); age and growth: the playing level (levels.py); flex: it plays a position up or down.
    __slots__ = ('key', 'num', 'role', 'tier', 'tagline', 'qs', 'r', 'bands', 'age', 'growth', 'slot', 'flex')

    def __init__(self, key, num, role, tier, tagline, qs, off, dfn):
        self.key, self.num, self.role, self.tier, self.tagline, self.qs = key, num, role, tier, tagline, qs
        self.age, self.growth, self.slot, self.flex = 'senior', None, num, False
        vals = DATA.parse(off) + DATA.parse(dfn)
        names = OFF + DEF
        self.r = {n: v for n, (v, _) in zip(names, vals)}
        self.bands = {n: b for n, (_, b) in zip(names, vals)}

    def shot(self, t):
        return self.r['shot_' + t]

    def con(self, t):
        return self.r['con_' + t]

    def __repr__(self):
        return f'Card({self.key})'


CARDS = {row[0]: Card(*row) for row in DATA.CARDS}
TEAMS = {name: [CARDS[k] for k in keys] for name, _, keys in TEAMS_MOD.TEAMS}
TEAM_TAGLINES = {name: tag for name, tag, _ in TEAMS_MOD.TEAMS}
FIRST_GAME = TEAMS_MOD.FIRST_GAME
SCENARIO_CARDS = SCEN_MOD.SC


# ---- custom lineups (step 3d) ------------------------------------------------------------------------
PRESCRIBED = [name for name, _, _ in TEAMS_MOD.TEAMS]
CUSTOM = {}


def register_team(name, keys):
    """Add a custom lineup to TEAMS and return the name it is registered under. The same name with the
    same cards is reused; a name already taken by other cards gets ' (2)', ' (3)' ..."""
    keys = [str(k) for k in keys]
    if len(keys) != 5 or any(k not in CARDS for k in keys):
        raise ValueError('a custom team is five card keys')
    base = ' '.join(str(name or '').split())[:30] or 'Custom'
    n, i = base, 2
    while n in TEAMS and [c.key for c in TEAMS[n]] != keys:
        n, i = f'{base} ({i})', i + 1
    if n not in TEAMS:
        TEAMS[n] = [CARDS[k] for k in keys]
        TEAM_TAGLINES[n] = 'Custom team'
        CUSTOM[n] = keys
    return n


def register_cards(name, cards, tagline='Custom team'):
    """Add a lineup of Card objects as they play (step 3l: effective cards, slot order) to TEAMS and return the name it
    is registered under. Same rule as register_team: the same name with the same cards is reused, else ' (2)' ..."""
    sig = lambda cs: [(c.key, getattr(c, 'age', 'senior'), getattr(c, 'growth', None), getattr(c, 'slot', c.num))
                      for c in cs]
    cards = list(cards)
    base = ' '.join(str(name or '').split())[:40] or 'Custom'
    n, i = base, 2
    while n in TEAMS and sig(TEAMS[n]) != sig(cards):
        n, i = f'{base} ({i})', i + 1
    if n not in TEAMS:
        TEAMS[n] = cards
        TEAM_TAGLINES[n] = tagline
        CUSTOM[n] = [c.key for c in cards]
    return n

"""The computer defence that reads the board (step 3e).

The greedy baseline scores a defensive action by the carrier's shot *right now*, judged from the current
arrow facings. That makes "arrow on the shooter" win almost every time, although any defender with their
Move and a token left can turn (or step in) to face the shooter as a reaction once the shot is declared.

This defence scores each candidate turn with the solver's evaluation instead, which already counts
reaction-reachable contests (a defender whose Move is unused, who is not locked, with a token in the
pool, can still get adjacent and facing as a reaction) and looks one offence turn ahead (shoot now,
drive, or pass and then shoot). Walls and lanes start to score, and holding a reaction back is valued.

It plays only from the legal actions, reads only the board and the cards (what a human sees), and never
looks at the offence's secret Coach's Call target.
"""
from . import board as B
from . import geometry as G
from .actions import legal_actions
from .policies import Policy, GreedyPolicy, expected
from .resolve import apply, ChanceNode


def arrow_job(state, j):
    """What defender j's arrow is doing, in the rules' four jobs (for logs, tests and the review):
    'on_ball' (on the ball carrier: Steal and a clean contest), 'wall' (adjacent to the carrier, line
    across the carrier's way to the rim), 'lane' (the line crosses a pass from the carrier to a teammate),
    'help' (the line crosses the carrier's drive path to the rim), 'on_man' (on the nearest other
    attacker) or 'other'."""
    xp, a = state.x[j], state.arrows[j]
    cp = state.o[state.ball]          # off the court during an inbound: only the lanes matter then
    inside = B.on_board(cp)
    R = state.ctx.rules
    if G.faces(R, a, xp, cp):
        return 'on_ball'
    rim = B.RIM
    if inside and B.adjacent(xp, cp) and G.crosses(R, xp, a, cp, rim):
        return 'wall'
    for i, op in enumerate(state.o):
        if i != state.ball and B.on_board(op) and G.crosses(R, xp, a, cp, op):
            return 'lane'
    if inside and G.crosses(R, xp, a, cp, rim):
        return 'help'
    others = [op for i, op in enumerate(state.o) if i != state.ball and B.on_board(op)]
    if others:
        near = min(others, key=lambda op: B.cheb(op, xp))
        if B.adjacent(xp, near) and a == B.dir_between(xp, near):
            return 'on_man'
    return 'other'


DEFAULT_BUDGET_S = 2.5          # thinking time per decision (the in-browser build sets a lower one)


class ReadingDefence(Policy):
    """Defence: the candidate turn (the solver's defence plays, plus every single legal action for the
    reaction and the contest choice) with the lowest value under the solver's two-turn evaluation.
    Offence: the greedy baseline (unchanged)."""
    name = 'reader'

    def __init__(self, eval_turns=1, budget_s='default'):
        budget_s = DEFAULT_BUDGET_S if budget_s == 'default' else budget_s
        self.budget_s = budget_s      # thinking time per decision; the best play so far is used after that
        from .solver import Evaluator, Generator
        from .solver_config import with_config
        self.cfg = with_config(eval_turns=eval_turns)
        self._Evaluator, self._Generator = Evaluator, Generator
        self._ctx = None
        self._fresh()
        self.offence = GreedyPolicy()

    def _fresh(self):
        # the solver's caches key positions without their context (teams, rules): one set per context
        self.ev = self._Evaluator(self.cfg)
        self.gen = self._Generator(self.cfg, self.ev)
        self.plan = None

    def _context(self, state):
        if state.ctx is not self._ctx:
            self._ctx = state.ctx
            self._fresh()

    def reset(self, seed):
        self.offence.reset(seed)
        self.plan = None

    def choose(self, state):
        acts = legal_actions(state)
        if len(acts) == 1:
            return acts[0]
        defending = state.stage in ('contest', 'reaction') or (state.stage == 'play' and state.side == 'X')
        if not defending:
            return self.offence.choose(state)
        self._context(state)
        if self.plan and self.plan[0] == state and self.plan[1]:
            a = self.plan[1][0]
            if a in acts:
                self._advance(state, a, self.plan[1][1:])
                return a
        self.plan = None
        best = self.best_play(state, acts)
        if best is None:
            return GreedyPolicy().choose(state)
        a = best.actions[0]
        self._advance(state, a, best.actions[1:])
        return a

    def _advance(self, state, a, rest):
        nxt = apply(state, a)
        self.plan = (nxt, rest) if rest and not isinstance(nxt, ChanceNode) else None

    def value(self, node):
        return expected(node, lambda s: self.ev(s)[0].ev)

    def best_play(self, state, acts=None):
        from .solver import Play, apply_play
        self._context(state)
        if state.ctx.coach_call and state.stage != 'over':
            state = state.with_(target=-1)        # the defence never sees the offence's secret target
        acts = acts if acts is not None else legal_actions(state)
        plays = self.gen.plays(state, shallow=False)
        if state.stage in ('reaction', 'contest') or state.pending:
            have = {p.actions for p in plays}
            plays += [Play('single', (a,)) for a in acts if (a,) not in have]
        import time
        stop = time.time() + self.budget_s if self.budget_s else None
        best, best_v = None, None
        for p in plays:
            if stop is not None and best is not None and time.time() > stop:
                break
            node = apply_play(state, p)
            if node is None:
                continue
            v = self.value(node)
            # spend a token only for a real gain: ties go to the play with fewer actions
            v += sum(a.kind != 'end_turn' for a in p.actions) * 1e-6
            if best_v is None or v < best_v:
                best, best_v = p, v
        return best


def choose_arrows(state, passes=2):
    """Setup arrows for a placed defence: start from each defender facing its man, then (coordinate
    descent) turn one defender at a time to the facing that leaves the offence the lowest value under the
    solver's evaluation. Squares are not changed."""
    from .solver import Evaluator
    from .solver_config import with_config
    ev = Evaluator(with_config(eval_turns=1))
    arrows = list(state.arrows)
    best = ev(state)[0].ev
    for _ in range(passes):
        changed = False
        for j in range(5):
            for d in range(8):
                if d == arrows[j]:
                    continue
                trial = arrows[:j] + [d] + arrows[j + 1:]
                v = ev(state.with_(arrows=tuple(trial)))[0].ev
                if v < best - 1e-9:
                    best, arrows, changed = v, trial, True
        if not changed:
            break
    return arrows

"""Every limit, width, depth, weight and verdict threshold the solver uses."""
from dataclasses import dataclass, replace


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SolverConfig:
    # ---- exact endgame solver ----
    endgame_tokens: int = 2          # N: positions in the final phase with <= N tokens per side go exact
    exact_node_cap: int = 4000       # give up on an exact solve after this many applies (fall back to guided)
    # ---- candidate generator ----
    top_k_raw: int = 8               # K: best raw actions (by evaluation) added to the concept plays
    raw_depth: int = 1               # add raw actions only this many plies from the root
    drive_k: int = 3                 # drive / drive-and-shoot squares per node
    relocate_k: int = 2              # off-ball relocations per node
    closeout_k: int = 4              # closeouts per node (outside the reaction to a shot)
    combo_k: int = 3                 # defence two-action combos built from the top single plays
    contain_k: int = 2               # the carrier's best step-then-shoot squares the defence plays to contain
    # ---- guided search ----
    beam: int = 6                    # plays kept per node below the root (ordered by evaluation)
    root_beam: int = 40              # plays kept at the root
    max_depth: int = 12              # iterative deepening limit, in turns
    # ---- evaluation ----
    eval_turns: int = 2              # the evaluation looks over the offence's next N turns (1 or 2)
    eval_setup_k: int = 4            # offence setup plays (pass / relocate / drive...) tried in turn 1
    eval_reply_k: int = 4            # defence replies tried to each setup
    # small positional terms (kept only if they improve agreement with the exact solver; see report)
    term_open_lane: float = 0.0      # per point of the best open-lane receiver's look above the carrier's
    term_zone: float = 0.0           # bonus if the carrier stands on a shooting zone (not plain wood)
    quiescence: bool = True          # a leaf where the defence is to move gets one more defence turn
    quiescence_beam: int = 12        # defence plays kept in that extra turn (ball-side plays only, no combos)
    kick_weight: float = 0.0         # value of the best teammate look (0 = carrier only); tested in the report
    inbound_kick_weight: float = 1.0 # during an inbound the ball must go in: use the best receiver's look
    # ---- budgets and confidence ----
    budgets_min: tuple = (2.0, 10.0) # time budgets per card, minutes
    seeds: int = 5
    unstable_spread: float = 2.0     # value spread (points) above which a card is unstable
    # ---- verdicts ----
    gift_p30: float = 0.75
    wall_p30: float = 0.15
    wall_look: float = 20.0
    plan_share: float = 0.90         # a plan counts if it reaches this share of the best value
    goal: int = 30


DEFAULT = SolverConfig()


def with_config(**kw):
    return replace(DEFAULT, **kw)

"""Step 3l: playing levels (the designer's two dials, Age and Standard) on top of the cards. No rule of play changes:
only which ratings the cards carry. data/levels_data.py is the source of truth (pure literals, never edited).

  effective_card(card, age, growth_tag, slot)  the card as it plays at that age, with that growth tag, in that slot
  Age   senior  the pro cards (data.CARDS), unchanged
        youth   the pro cards + YOUTH_MODIFIER (marks unchanged: the band edges shift by the same amounts)
        junior  JUNIOR_CARDS (the U16 cards), + the growth tag's changes (marks unchanged: the card shows on time)
  Clamps after any modifier or tag: ratings 0 to 19 (Pass 20), Quick Step 0 to 2.
"""
import random

from . import cards as CD

LD = CD._load('levels_data')
AGES = LD.AGES
STANDARDS = LD.STANDARDS
TIER_VALUE = LD.TIER_VALUE
GROWTH = LD.GROWTH
GROWTH_DEAL = LD.GROWTH_DEAL
YOUTH_MODIFIER = LD.YOUTH_MODIFIER
LEVEL_INFO = LD.LEVEL_INFO
AGE_ORDER = ('senior', 'youth', 'junior')
STANDARD_ORDER = ('pro', 'semi_pro', 'amateur')
TAGS = ('early', 'typical', 'late')   # D-88: internal names only; a log from before step 6 says on_time
LABEL = {'senior': None, 'youth': 'U20', 'junior': 'U16'}

JUNIOR = {row[0]: CD.Card(*row) for row in LD.JUNIOR_CARDS}


def clamp(name, v):
    if name == 'qs':
        return max(0, min(2, v))
    return max(0, min(20 if name == 'pass' else 19, v))


_CACHE = {}


def effective_card(card, age='senior', growth_tag=None, slot=None):
    """The card as it plays: base ratings for the age, the youth modifier or the growth tag, clamped. Marks (bands) are
    the printed card's. slot: the slot it fills (1 to 5; None = its own position)."""
    key = card.key if hasattr(card, 'key') else card
    age = age or 'senior'
    tag = growth_tag if (age == 'junior' and growth_tag in ('early', 'late')) else None
    slot = slot or CD.CARDS[key].num
    ck = (key, age, tag, slot)
    hit = _CACHE.get(ck)
    if hit is not None:
        return hit
    base = JUNIOR[key] if age == 'junior' else CD.CARDS[key]
    delta = {}
    if age == 'youth':
        delta.update(YOUTH_MODIFIER)
    if tag:
        for k, v in GROWTH[tag].items():
            delta[k] = delta.get(k, 0) + v
    c = CD.Card.__new__(CD.Card)
    c.key, c.num, c.role, c.tier, c.tagline = base.key, base.num, base.role, base.tier, base.tagline
    c.qs = clamp('qs', base.qs + delta.get('qs', 0))
    c.r = {n: clamp(n, v + delta.get(n, 0)) for n, v in base.r.items()}
    c.bands = dict(base.bands)                    # marks never change
    c.age, c.growth, c.slot = age, tag, slot      # step 6: only a growth that changes the card (early or late) is recorded
    c.flex = slot != base.num
    _CACHE[ck] = c
    return c


def team(entries, age='senior', tags=None):
    """A team as it plays: entries [(key, slot)] or [key, ...] (slot = list position + 1), ordered by slot (the slot
    sets the piece: O1 is slot 1). tags: {slot: 'early' | 'typical' | 'late'} or a list in slot order."""
    ents = []
    for i, e in enumerate(entries):
        k, s = (e if isinstance(e, (tuple, list)) else (e, i + 1))
        ents.append((k.key if hasattr(k, 'key') else k, int(s)))
    ents.sort(key=lambda e: e[1])
    if isinstance(tags, (list, tuple)):
        tags = {i + 1: t for i, t in enumerate(tags)}
    tags = tags or {}
    return [effective_card(k, age, tags.get(s), s) for k, s in ents]


def deal_growth(rng):
    """One team's growth tags, slot order: 1 early, 3 typical, 1 late, shuffled (the same deal as before step 6)."""
    bag = [t for t, n in (('early', GROWTH_DEAL['early']), ('typical', GROWTH_DEAL['typical']), ('late', GROWTH_DEAL['late']))
           for _ in range(n)]
    rng.shuffle(bag)
    return bag


def growth_line(tag):
    """D-88: Coach Vision's one line on a junior whose growth changes his card (no tag names); None for the others."""
    if tag == 'early':
        return 'Bigger and stronger than most players his age.'
    if tag == 'late':
        return 'Still growing: smaller and slower than most players his age.'
    return None


def card_label(card):
    """'U16 · TIER A' for a junior card, 'U20 · TIER A' for a youth card, 'TIER A' for a senior card."""
    lab = LABEL.get(getattr(card, 'age', 'senior') or 'senior')
    return f'{lab} · TIER {card.tier}' if lab else f'TIER {card.tier}'


# ---- the levels sheet's wording (the in-app text matches the printed sheet) -----------------------------------------
AGE_WORDS = {
    'senior': 'Senior: the pro cards.',
    'youth': 'Elite youth · U18 to U20: the pro cards, plus every shot and free throw −1; Steal and Intercept +1. '
             'Young players shoot about 4 points worse and lose the ball to steals more often; fouls and contests are the same.',
    'junior': 'Junior · U14 to U16: the U16 cards. Weaker shooting and ball security, types closer together, and size and '
              'speed set by growth, not position.',
}
STANDARD_WORDS = {
    'pro': 'Pro: BBBBB · ABBBC · AABCC. The full range of tiers.',
    'semi_pro': 'Semi-pro: BBBBC · ABBCC. A little below pro.',
    'amateur': 'Amateur: BBCCC · ACCCC. Mostly C. ACCCC is the club with one standout.',
}
SHEET_INTRO = ('These levels are representative: they reproduce how each level of basketball differs from the pros, not any '
               'one league exactly. The pro cards are set at senior pro level (FIBA and NBL). The rules never change. Set two '
               'dials before you build teams, the same for both sides.')
STANDARD_NOTE = ('Pick any shape in your standard; every shape in a row is equal strength (A = +1, B = 0, C = −1). Lower tiers '
                 'weaken offence and defence together, as real lower leagues do, and amateur players are the most spread out: '
                 'the best are close to pro, the rest well short. For a handicap, give the less experienced player a higher standard.')
GROWTH_BOX = ('In the app, growth changes two players on each junior team, dealt at random: one is bigger and stronger than most '
              'players his age, one is still growing. The cards show the ratings he plays with, and Coach Vision names the two. '
              'At the table the junior cards play as printed.')


# ---- lineups in the logs (the review rebuilds the teams as they played) ---------------------------------------------
def lineup_spec(cards):
    """[[key, slot, tag or None], ...] in slot order: enough, with the age, to rebuild the team."""
    return [[c.key, getattr(c, 'slot', c.num), getattr(c, 'growth', None)] for c in cards]


def from_spec(spec, age='senior'):
    return team([(k, s) for k, s, _ in spec], age, {s: t for _, s, t in spec if t})


def as_printed(cards):
    """The same team with its growth face down (every junior card as printed)."""
    return [effective_card(c.key, getattr(c, 'age', 'senior'), None, getattr(c, 'slot', c.num)) for c in cards]


def flex_words(card):
    """'playing the 4' for a card in a slot next to its printed position, else ''."""
    return f'playing the {card.slot}' if getattr(card, 'flex', False) else ''


ROSTER_WORDS = {
    'prescribed': 'Prescribed teams: the six designed teams, as printed (pro standard). The age dial still applies.',
    'build': 'Build your teams, rules on: five different cards in a shape of your standard, one card in each slot 1 to '

"""Step 3m: the computer player on the new decision engine (replaces steps 3e to 3k for decisions).

One agent for every level; the levels differ only by ai_profiles.json (B8): search depth and beam, the opponent model,
evaluation noise, attention (the threats and defenders read: those nearest the ball), reaction delay (Rookie reads
the board as it was before the opponent's last turn), the goal-switch margin, the variety margin, the time budget and
(All-Star) scouting the human from stored games. Age stays in the ratings.

Each turn: an anytime search (search.Searcher) scores whole turns; noise is added at the root; goals (goals.py) are
read from the scored turns and held with hysteresis; a turn toward the held goal is chosen, then one at random among
the turns within the variety margin. The turn's actions are played one at a time (a roll ends the plan).
"""
import json
import random
import time

from . import board as B
from . import jsbridge
from . import rules_config as RC
from .actions import Action, legal_actions
from .decide import Read, CONFIG
from .goals import Commitment, goals_in, _likeliest
from .resolve import apply, ChanceNode
from .search import Searcher, play_turn, actor, zobrist, terminal_value

LEVELS = ('rookie', 'starter', 'allstar')
SCALE = {'value': 1.0}           # tests shrink the time budgets; the browser build can scale them
# step 3n Part A: the search core in JavaScript (playmaker_web/static/engine.js). The browser worker sets JS['search'] to
# PMEngine.searchJSON (JSON text in and out); tests may set it to a Node-backed call. None: the Python search.
JS = {'search': None, 'goals': None}
# step 3n Part B: the exam's fixed-depth run (the design verdict): every level searches exactly this depth, no time limit
FIXED = {'depth': None}


def profile(level):
    level = {'greedy': 'starter', 'reader': 'starter'}.get(level, level)
    return dict(CONFIG['profiles'][level], name=level)


def attention_sets(s, n):
    """The n attackers and n defenders nearest the ball (all five when n >= 5)."""
    if n >= 5:
        return None
    bp = s.o[s.ball]
    o = sorted(range(5), key=lambda i: (B.cheb(s.o[i], bp), i))[:n]
    if s.ball not in o:
        o = [s.ball] + o[:n - 1]
    x = sorted(range(5), key=lambda j: (B.cheb(s.x[j], bp), j))[:n]
    return (o, x)


class Agent:
    """The computer for one side (O or X), at one level."""
    name = 'computer'

    def __init__(self, side, level='starter', seed=0, scouting=None):
        self.side = side
        self.level = {'greedy': 'starter', 'reader': 'starter'}.get(level, level)
        if self.level not in LEVELS:
            raise ValueError('computer level: rookie, starter or allstar')
        self.p = profile(self.level)
        self.rng = random.Random(seed * 7919 + (1 if side == 'O' else 2))
        self.commit = Commitment(self.p['goal_margin_m0'])
        self.notes = []
        self.plan = []
        self.expect = None
        self.stale = None              # the opponent's pieces at this side's previous decision (reaction delay)
        self.scouting = scouting if self.p['scout_human'] else None
        self.last = None
        self.setup_perm = None

    def reset(self, seed):
        pass

    def describe(self):
        return dict(level=self.level, engine='step 3m decision engine', profile={k: v for k, v in self.p.items()
                                                                                if k != 'name'},
                    scouting=self.scouting_words())

    def scouting_words(self):
        sc = self.scouting
        if not sc or not sc.get('games'):
            return None
        bits = [f"read {sc['games']} of your completed games"]
        if sc.get('early_shot') is not None:
            bits.append(f"you shot in the first two phases {round(100 * sc['early_shot'])}% of the time")
        if sc.get('pass_risk') is not None:
            bits.append(f"your passes risked an interception {round(100 * sc['pass_risk'])}% of the time")
        if sc.get('drive') is not None:
            bits.append(f"you drove on {round(100 * sc['drive'])}% of your turns with the ball")
        if sc.get('help') is not None:
            bits.append(f"on defence you left your man to help {round(100 * sc['help'])}% of the time")
        return 'All-Star ' + '; '.join(bits) + '.'

    # -- the evaluation this profile sees
    def _evaluate(self, s0):
        att_n = self.p['attention']
        delay = self.p['reaction_delay']
        stale = self.stale

        def ev(node):
            if isinstance(node, ChanceNode):
                return sum(float(p) * ev(sub) for p, _, sub in node.outcomes)
            if node.stage == 'over':
                return terminal_value(node)
            s = node
            if delay == 'previous_board' and stale is not None:
                s = _with_stale(s, self.side, stale)
            att = attention_sets(s, att_n)
            return Read(s, attention=att, k=2 if att_n < 5 else None).leaf()
        return ev

    def choose(self, s):
        side = actor(s)
        # a planned second action, if the position is the one the plan expected
        if self.plan and self.expect == zobrist(s):
            a = self.plan.pop(0)
            if a in legal_actions(s):
                self.expect = None
                if self.plan:
                    nxt = apply(s, a)
                    self.expect = zobrist(nxt) if not isinstance(nxt, ChanceNode) else None
                    if self.expect is None:
                        self.plan = []
                return a
        self.plan, self.expect = [], None
        acts = legal_actions(s)
        if len(acts) == 1:
            return acts[0]
        if s.stage in ('contest', 'forced', 'target', 'pick'):
            return self._small(s, acts)
        t0 = time.time()
        budget = self.p['time_budget_s'] * SCALE['value']
        lo, hi = self.p['depth']
        if FIXED['depth']:
            lo = hi = FIXED['depth']
            budget = None
            if FIXED.get('deadline') is not None:      # step 12: a tool's cap on a fixed look-ahead (the deepest that finishes)
                budget = max(5.0, FIXED['deadline'] - time.time())
        if JS['search'] is not None and jsbridge.ported(s.ctx.rules):
            results, reached, srch = self._js_search(s, budget, hi)
        else:
            srch = Searcher(side, self.p, self._evaluate(s), t0 + budget if budget is not None else float('inf'), self.rng)
            if self.scouting and self.scouting.get('habit'):
                srch.habit = self.scouting['habit']
                srch.habit_weight = self.scouting.get('weight', 0.3)
            results, reached = srch.root(s, hi, lo)
        sign = 1 if side == 'O' else -1
        if CONFIG.get('search', {}).get('split_ties') is True:
            # step 18f (search.split_ties): turns that read exactly the same get one draw of the pick noise, so the
            # evidence that put them in order chooses between them, not chance
            scored, prev, nz = [], None, 0.0
            for v, t in results:
                if prev is None or abs(v - prev) >= 1e-9:
                    nz = self.rng.gauss(0, self.p['noise'])
                prev = v
                scored.append((sign * v + nz, t, sign * v))
        else:
            scored = [(sign * v + self.rng.gauss(0, self.p['noise']), t, sign * v) for v, t in results]
        top8 = sorted(scored, key=lambda r: -r[0])[:8]
        with_goals = []
        if getattr(srch, 'engine', None) == 'js' and JS.get('goals') is not None:
            # the goals of the turns weighed, read by the JavaScript core (the same predicates, goals.goals_in)
            req = dict(state=jsbridge.state_json(s), ctx=jsbridge.ctx_json(s.ctx), side=side,
                       turns=[[[a.kind, a.side, a.piece, B.sq(a.dest) if a.dest else None, a.arrow, a.target, a.shot]
                               for a in t] for _, t, _ in top8])
            g = json.loads(JS['goals'](json.dumps(req)))
            base = sign * g['base']
            for (v, t, raw), gl in zip(top8, g['goals']):
                with_goals.append((v, t, {tuple(k): w for k, w in gl}))
        else:
            base_read = Read(s)
            base = sign * base_read.leaf()
            for v, t, raw in top8:
                after = _likeliest(play_turn(s, t))
                gs = goals_in(s, after, side, base_read, None if after.stage == 'over' else Read(after), t) \
                    if after.stage != 'over' else {}
                with_goals.append((v, t, gs))
        n_log = len(self.commit.log)
        turn, val = self.commit.choose(s, side, with_goals, base, None)
        # variety: one at random among the turns within the variety margin of the chosen one
        near = [t for v, t, _ in with_goals if v >= val - self.p['variety_margin']]
        if CONFIG.get('search', {}).get('split_ties') is True:
            # variety is between turns that read differently: of those that read the same, the first only
            seen, near = set(), []
            for v, t, _ in with_goals:
                if v >= val - self.p['variety_margin'] and round(v, 9) not in seen:
                    seen.add(round(v, 9))
                    near.append(t)
        if self.p['variety_margin'] > 0 and len(near) > 1:
            turn = self.rng.choice(near)
        took = round(time.time() - t0, 3)
        stable = dict(extensions=getattr(srch, 'extensions', 0), cap_hits=getattr(srch, 'cap_hits', 0),
                      kept=getattr(srch, 'kept', 0)) if getattr(srch, 'stable', False) else None
        trace = [[d, [str(a) for a in t], round(v, 2)] for d, t, v in getattr(srch, 'trace', [])]
        note = dict(event='decision', level=self.level, depth=reached, partial=getattr(srch, 'partial', 0), stable=stable,
                    trace=trace, depth_seconds=[list(x) for x in getattr(srch, 'depth_seconds', [])],
                    engine=getattr(srch, 'engine', 'python'), pv=getattr(srch, 'pv', None),
                    leaves=srch.leaves, nodes=srch.nodes,
                    seconds=took, value=round(val, 2), turn=[str(a) for a in turn],
                    goal=self.commit.words or None,
                    alternatives=[dict(turn=[str(a) for a in t], value=round(v, 2)) for v, t, _ in with_goals[:3]])
        if CONFIG['eval'].get('learned') is True:
            note['why'] = self._why(s, turn, with_goals, val)   # step 17: the reasons, in the readings' own words
        if CONFIG['eval'].get('advantages') is True and side in ('O', 'X'):
            note['goals'] = self._goal_note(s, turn)          # step 16: reading and recording only
        for g in self.commit.log[n_log:]:
            self.notes.append(dict(event='goal', **g))
        why = steal_reason(s, turn)
        if why:
            note['reason'] = why
        self.notes.append(note)
        self.last = note
        self.stale = (s.x, s.arrows) if self.side == 'O' else (s.o,)
        a = turn[0]
        if len(turn) > 1:
            nxt = apply(s, a)
            if not isinstance(nxt, ChanceNode) and nxt.stage != 'over':
                self.plan = list(turn[1:])
                self.expect = zobrist(nxt)
        return a

    def _why(self, s, turn, weighed, val):
        """Step 17 (reporting only): why this turn and not the runner-up. The three readings whose weighted parts
        differ most between the positions the two turns lead to (the likeliest outcome of each), in points, in the
        readings' own words. close_call: the gap between the two turns is inside what the weights' spread allows.
        unsure: a reading whose weight changes sign across the 20 resampled fits."""
        from .decide import FEATURES, learned_weights
        from .search import phase_of
        w = learned_weights()
        others = [(v, t) for v, t, _ in weighed if t != turn]
        if w is None or not others:
            return None
        v2, runner = max(others, key=lambda r: r[0])

        def parts(t):
            after = _likeliest(play_turn(s, t))
            if after.stage != 'play' or after.pending:
                return None
            m = w['phases'].get(phase_of(after))
            if m is None:
                return None
            f = Read(after).features()
            z = [(f[i] - m['mean'][i]) / m['sd'][i] for i in range(len(f))]
            return [m['weights'][i] * z[i] for i in range(len(f))], z, m
        a, b = parts(turn), parts(runner)
        out = dict(chosen=[str(x) for x in turn], runner_up=[str(x) for x in runner], gap=round(val - v2, 2))
        if a is None or b is None:
            out['reasons'] = ['one of the two turns ends the possession or leaves a pass in the air: its value is the dice\'s']
            return out
        diff = [a[0][i] - b[0][i] for i in range(len(FEATURES))]
        spread = sum((a[2]['weights_spread'][i] * (a[1][i] - b[1][i])) ** 2 for i in range(len(FEATURES))) ** 0.5
        top = sorted(range(len(FEATURES)), key=lambda i: -abs(diff[i]))[:3]
        sign = 1 if self.side == 'O' else -1
        out['reasons'] = [f"{FEATURES[i][1]}: {'+' if sign * diff[i] >= 0 else '-'}{abs(diff[i]):.1f} for this turn"
                          for i in top if abs(diff[i]) > 0.05]
        out['close_call'] = abs(val - v2) < 1.96 * spread
        out['unsure'] = [FEATURES[i][0] for i in top if abs(a[2]['weights'][i]) < 1.96 * a[2]['weights_spread'][i]]
        return out

    def _goal_note(self, s, turn):
        """Step 16 (for the trainer later): the top goals on the board, their stages, the goal the computer is on (it
        changes only when another beats it by more than the reading's margin of error), the event (ready, lost,
        switched, clock), the defence's mirror answer to each, and which looks the chosen turn raised or lowered."""
        from .search import phase_of
        r0 = Read(s)
        adv = sorted(r0.advantages(), key=lambda a: (-a['worth'], a['i']))
        keys = {(a['kind'], a['i']): a for a in adv}
        margin = float(CONFIG.get('search', {}).get('stable_margin', {}).get(phase_of(s), 0.0))
        best = adv[0] if adv and adv[0]['worth'] > 1e-9 else None
        cur, event = getattr(self, 'goal', None), None
        if cur is not None and (cur not in keys or keys[cur]['worth'] <= 1e-9):
            cur, event = None, 'lost'
        if cur is None:
            cur = (best['kind'], best['i']) if best else None
        elif best and (best['kind'], best['i']) != cur and best['worth'] > keys[cur]['worth'] + margin:
            cur, event = (best['kind'], best['i']), 'switched'
        if cur is not None and keys[cur]['stage'] == 'convert':
            event = event or 'ready'
        if s.clock <= RC.PHASE_SECONDS:
            event = 'clock'
        self.goal = cur
        answer = {'create': 'prevent', 'keep': 'break', 'convert': 'deny'}
        goals = [dict(kind=a['kind'], attacker=f"O{a['i'] + 1}", defender=f"X{a['j'] + 1}" if a['j'] >= 0 else None,
                      square=B.sq(a['sq']) if a['sq'] else None, stage=a['stage'], value=round(a['value'], 1),
                      chance=round(a['chance'], 2), worth=round(a['worth'], 1), gap=a['gap'],
                      defence='run down' if s.clock <= RC.PHASE_SECONDS else answer[a['stage']] if a['worth'] > 1e-9
                      else 'concede') for a in adv[:6]]
        changed = {}
        after = _likeliest(play_turn(s, turn))
        if after.stage == 'play' and not after.pending:
            r1 = Read(after)
            for i in range(5):
                d = r1.threat[i]['value'] - r0.threat[i]['value']
                if abs(d) > 0.05:
                    changed[f'O{i + 1}'] = round(d, 1)
        return dict(goals=goals, current=f'{cur[0]} O{cur[1] + 1}' if cur else None, event=event, potential=round(r0.phi(), 2),
                    target=B.sq(keys[cur]['sq']) if cur and keys[cur]['sq'] else None,
                    looks_changed=changed)

    def _js_search(self, s, budget, max_depth):
        """The same search in JavaScript (engine.js, proved equal to search.Searcher by tools/js_equivalence.py)."""
        sq = B.sq
        stale = None
        if self.stale is not None and self.p['reaction_delay'] == 'previous_board':
            stale = [[sq(q) for q in self.stale[0]], list(self.stale[1])] if self.side == 'O' else [[sq(q) for q in self.stale[0]]]
        req = dict(state=jsbridge.state_json(s), ctx=jsbridge.ctx_json(s.ctx), profile=self.p, budget=budget,
                   max_depth=max_depth, stale=stale)
        if self.scouting and self.scouting.get('habit'):
            req['habit'] = self.scouting['habit']
            req['habit_weight'] = self.scouting.get('weight', 0.3)
        out = json.loads(JS['search'](json.dumps(req)))
        results = [(v, tuple(jsbridge.action_from(a) for a in t)) for v, t in out['results']]

        class _Stats:
            pass
        st = _Stats()
        st.leaves, st.nodes, st.partial, st.pv = out['leaves'], out['nodes'], out['partial'], out.get('pv')
        st.engine = 'js'
        st.stable = out.get('stable', False)
        st.extensions, st.cap_hits, st.kept = out.get('extensions', 0), out.get('cap_hits', 0), out.get('kept', 0)
        st.trace = [(d, tuple(jsbridge.action_from(a) for a in t), v) for d, t, v in out.get('trace', [])]
        st.depth_seconds = [(d, round(x, 3)) for d, x in out.get('depth_seconds', [])]
        return results, out['reached'], st

    def _small(self, s, acts):
        """Contest choice, forced shot type, Coach's Call target, failed-inbound pick: one step, valued exactly."""
        side = actor(s)
        ev = self._evaluate(s)

        def val(a):
            n = apply(s, a)
            return ev(n)
        best = max(acts, key=val) if side == 'O' else min(acts, key=val)
        return best


def steal_reason(s, turn):
    """Step 3n F4: why the defence reached for a steal or didn't, in plain words, when the bonus line matters."""
    if actor(s) != 'X' or not s.ctx.rules.digital or s.stage != 'play':
        return None
    if not any(a.kind == 'steal' for a in legal_actions(s)):
        return None
    f, b = s.ctx.team_fouls + s.fouls, s.ctx.rules.bonus_from
    reached = any(a.kind == 'steal' for a in turn)
    if reached:
        return (f'Reached for the steal: {f} team foul{"s" if f != 1 else ""}, so a foul costs 5 points and play goes on.'
                if f + 1 < b else f'Reached for the steal even though a foul now gives free throws.')
    if f + 1 >= b:
        return (f'Didn\'t reach for the steal: a foul now would be their {f + 1}th team foul, and from the {b}th a steal '
                f'foul gives free throws.')
    return None


def _with_stale(s, side, stale):
    """The board as this side saw it before the opponent's last turn (Rookie's reaction delay): the opponent's pieces
    where they stood then, if those squares are free now."""
    if side == 'O':
        xs, arrows = stale
        if set(xs) & set(s.o):
            return s
        return s.with_(x=xs, arrows=arrows)
    (os_,) = stale
    if set(os_) & set(s.x):
        return s
    return s.with_(o=os_)


# ---- setup (B6) -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _legal_o(sq, ball):
    return (len(set(sq)) == 5 and all(B.on_board(q) for q in sq) and B.zone(sq[ball]) == '.' and sq[ball][1] > 1)


def _o_value(make, o_sq, ball, rng, budget_end):
    xs, arrows = _defence_reply(make, o_sq, ball, rng, budget_end, rounds=1)
    s = make(o_sq, ball, xs, arrows)
    return Read(s).leaf(), xs, arrows


def _defence_reply(make, o_sq, ball, rng, budget_end, rounds=3, perm=None):
    """The defence's placement by best cover: start from each defender on the empty square next to an attacker that
    is nearest the rim (step 3k's legal man-to-man start), then improve one defender at a time over the empty squares
    near the attackers and every arrow, minimising the offence's position value. Returns (squares, arrows)."""
    from playmaker_web.game import man_to_man
    xs, arrows = man_to_man(list(o_sq), ball)
    if perm is not None:
        xs2 = [None] * 5
        ar2 = [None] * 5
        for j in range(5):
            xs2[j], ar2[j] = xs[perm[j]], arrows[perm[j]]
        xs, arrows = xs2, ar2
    xs, arrows = list(xs), list(arrows)

    def v(xq, ar):
        try:
            return Read(make(o_sq, ball, xq, ar)).leaf()
        except ValueError:
            return 1e9
    cur = v(xs, arrows)
    occ_o = set(o_sq)
    cands = sorted({(x, y) for (ox, oy) in o_sq for x in range(ox - 3, ox + 4) for y in range(oy - 3, oy + 4)
                    if B.on_board((x, y)) and (x, y) not in occ_o})
    for _ in range(rounds):
        improved = False
        for j in rng.sample(range(5), 5):
            if time.time() > budget_end:
                return xs, arrows
            pool = [q for q in cands if q not in xs or q == xs[j]]
            pool = rng.sample(pool, min(len(pool), 14))
            for q in pool:
                for a in {B.nearest_dir(q, o_sq[ball]), B.nearest_dir(q, min(o_sq, key=lambda p: B.cheb(p, q)))}:
                    if q == xs[j] and a == arrows[j]:
                        continue
                    xq = xs[:j] + [q] + xs[j + 1:]
                    ar = arrows[:j] + [a] + arrows[j + 1:]
                    val = v(xq, ar)
                    if val < cur - 1e-9:
                        xs, arrows, cur, improved = xq, ar, val, True
        if not improved:
            break
    return xs, arrows


def propose_offence(make_names, seed, levels_key=None, budget=None, level='allstar'):
    """The offence's setup (B6): the placement that maximises V against the defence's best reply placement, searched
    over sampled legal placements and refined locally. It never sees the real defence. make_names(o_names, x_names,
    arrows, ball) builds the state. Returns dict(squares, ball, text, value, candidates)."""
    p = profile(level)
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    t0 = time.time()
    t_end = t0 + (budget if budget is not None else max(0.2, p['time_budget_s']) * SCALE['value'])
    make = lambda o, b, x, a: make_names([B.sq(q) for q in o], [B.sq(q) for q in x], list(a), b)
    from playmaker_web.game import TABLE_O
    base = [B.parse_sq(q) for q in TABLE_O]
    cands = [(base, 0)]
    plain = [(x, y) for x in range(B.W) for y in range(2, B.H + 1) if B.zone((x, y)) == '.']
    near = [(x, y) for x in range(B.W) for y in range(1, 11)]
    for _ in range(24):
        bq = rng.choice(plain)
        rest = rng.sample([q for q in near if q != bq], 4)
        cands.append(([bq] + rest, 0))
    scored = []
    # screen every sampled placement against the defence's man-to-man start (cheap), then give the best few the
    # defence's best-cover reply, then refine the best one player at a time
    from playmaker_web.game import man_to_man
    for sq, ball in cands:
        if not _legal_o(sq, ball):
            continue
        xs, ar = man_to_man(list(sq), ball)
        try:
            v = Read(make(sq, ball, xs, ar)).leaf()
        except ValueError:
            continue
        scored.append((v, sq, ball))
        if time.time() > t_end - 0.6 * (t_end - t0) and len(scored) >= 4:
            break
    scored.sort(key=lambda r: -r[0])
    top = []
    for v0, sq, ball in scored[:3]:
        v, _, _ = _o_value(make, sq, ball, rng, t_end)
        top.append((v, sq, ball))
    top.sort(key=lambda r: -r[0])
    best_v, best_sq, best_ball = top[0]

    offence's position value). Returns dict(squares, arrows, perm, text, value)."""
    p = profile(level)
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    t_end = time.time() + (budget if budget is not None else max(0.2, p['time_budget_s']) * SCALE['value'])
    make = lambda o, b, x, a: make_names([B.sq(q) for q in o], [B.sq(q) for q in x], list(a), b)
    xs, arrows = _defence_reply(make, list(o_sq), ball, rng, t_end, rounds=3)
    s = make(list(o_sq), ball, xs, arrows)

    perm = []
    for j in range(5):
        perm.append(min(range(5), key=lambda i: (B.cheb(xs[j], o_sq[i]), i)))
    words = []
    for j in range(5):
        i = perm[j]
        d = B.cheb(xs[j], o_sq[i])

    return dict(squares=xs, arrows=arrows, perm=perm, value=round(r.leaf(), 2), text=text)

"""Glicko-2 (Glickman, "Example of the Glicko-2 system", glicko.net/glicko/glicko2.pdf), step for step.

rate(rating, rd, vol, results, tau) -> (rating, rd, vol); results: [(opponent rating, opponent rd, score 0..1)].
A rating period with no games only widens the deviation.
"""
import math

SCALE = 173.7178


def _g(phi):
    return 1.0 / math.sqrt(1.0 + 3.0 * phi * phi / (math.pi * math.pi))


def _E(mu, mu_j, phi_j):
    return 1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-_g(phi_j) * (mu - mu_j)))


def rate(rating, rd, vol, results, tau=0.5, eps=1e-6):
    mu = (rating - 1500.0) / SCALE
    phi = rd / SCALE
    if not results:                                   # step 6 only: the deviation grows
        phi_star = math.sqrt(phi * phi + vol * vol)
        return rating, phi_star * SCALE, vol
    opp = [((r - 1500.0) / SCALE, d / SCALE, s) for r, d, s in results]
    v_inv = 0.0
    delta_sum = 0.0
    for mu_j, phi_j, s in opp:
        g = _g(phi_j)
        e = _E(mu, mu_j, phi_j)
        v_inv += g * g * e * (1 - e)
        delta_sum += g * (s - e)
    v = 1.0 / v_inv
    delta = v * delta_sum
    # step 5: the new volatility (Illinois algorithm)
    a = math.log(vol * vol)

    def f(x):
        ex = math.exp(x)
        return ex * (delta * delta - phi * phi - v - ex) / (2 * (phi * phi + v + ex) ** 2) - (x - a) / (tau * tau)
    A = a
    if delta * delta > phi * phi + v:
        B_ = math.log(delta * delta - phi * phi - v)
    else:
        k = 1
        while f(a - k * tau) < 0:
            k += 1
        B_ = a - k * tau
    fA, fB = f(A), f(B_)
    while abs(B_ - A) > eps:
        C = A + (A - B_) * fA / (fB - fA)
        fC = f(C)
        if fC * fB <= 0:
            A, fA = B_, fB
        else:
            fA /= 2
        B_, fB = C, fC
    new_vol = math.exp(A / 2)
    phi_star = math.sqrt(phi * phi + new_vol * new_vol)
    new_phi = 1.0 / math.sqrt(1.0 / (phi_star * phi_star) + 1.0 / v)
    new_mu = mu + new_phi * new_phi * delta_sum
    return new_mu * SCALE + 1500.0, new_phi * SCALE, new_vol


def expected(rating, rd, opp_rating, opp_rd):
    """The expected score against an opponent (both deviations counted)."""
    mu, mu_j = (rating - 1500.0) / SCALE, (opp_rating - 1500.0) / SCALE
    phi = math.sqrt((rd / SCALE) ** 2 + (opp_rd / SCALE) ** 2)
    return _E(mu, mu_j, phi)

state_json / ctx_json write a GameState and its Context as plain JSON for the JavaScript engine; action_from turns the
engine's action back into an Action. The Python engine stays the reference: engine.js is a port, proved equal on random
legal states by tools/js_equivalence.py, and plays only the ruled settings (both formats).
"""
from dataclasses import asdict, fields

from . import board as B
from . import rules_config as RC

_DEFAULTS = {f.name: getattr(RC.DEFAULT_RULES, f.name) for f in fields(RC.Rules)}
PORTED_FREE = ('digital', 'quarter_possessions', 'bonus_from')


def ported(rules):
    """Does engine.js play these rules? (every setting at its ruled value, except the format and the quarter)"""
    return all(getattr(rules, k) == v for k, v in _DEFAULTS.items() if k not in PORTED_FREE)


def card_json(c):
    return dict(qs=c.qs, r=dict(c.r), bands=dict(c.bands))      # bands (step 16): the card's H, A, L per rating


def ctx_json(ctx, table=None):

                two_or_three=ctx.two_or_three, hold_for_one=ctx.hold_for_one, team_fouls=ctx.team_fouls,
                quarter_left=ctx.quarter_left,

    sq = B.sq
    res = None
    if s.result is not None:
        res = asdict(s.result)
    return dict(o=[sq(p) for p in s.o], x=[sq(p) for p in s.x], arrows=list(s.arrows), ball=s.ball, stage=s.stage,
                side=s.side, clock=s.clock, tok_o=s.tok_o, tok_x=s.tok_x, moved_o=s.moved_o, moved_x=s.moved_x,
                cnt=list(s.cnt), turn_n=s.turn_n, final=s.final, lock_o=s.lock_o, lock_x=s.lock_x,
                screens=[list(t) for t in s.screens], pending=list(s.pending) if s.pending else None,
                approach=s.approach, shot=s.shot, prev_wait=s.prev_wait, beaten=[list(t) for t in s.beaten],
                fouls=s.fouls, bonus5=s.bonus5, tos=s.tos, inbound=s.inbound, target=s.target, result=res,
                zeroed=s.zeroed, phase=s.phase, turn_moved=s.turn_moved, qs_o=s.qs_o, qs_x=s.qs_x, forced=s.forced,
                react_moved=s.react_moved, turn_lead=s.turn_lead, rush_o=s.rush_o, rush_x=s.rush_x, key_o=s.key_o, grd=s.grd,
                turn_x=[[sq(p) for p in s.turn_x[0]], list(s.turn_x[1])] if s.turn_x else [])


def action_from(t):
    """[kind, side, piece, dest square or None, arrow, target, shot] -> Action."""
    kind, side, piece, dest, arrow, target, shot = t
    return Action(kind, side, piece, B.parse_sq(dest) if dest else None, arrow, target, shot or '')


class NodeEngine:
    """engine.js in a long-running Node process, for the server, the tools and the tests (the browser runs it in the
    worker). install() points agent.JS at it; uninstall() restores the Python search."""

    def __init__(self):
        import os
        import subprocess
        here = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
        self.p = subprocess.Popen(['node', os.path.join(here, 'tools', 'js_server.js')], stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                                  stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)

    def call(self, fn, text):
        import json
        self.p.stdin.write(json.dumps(dict(fn=fn, text=text)) + '\n')
        self.p.stdin.flush()
        out = json.loads(self.p.stdout.readline())
        if 'error' in out:
            raise RuntimeError(out['error'])
        return out['ok']

    def install(self):
        from . import agent as AG
        AG.JS['search'] = lambda t: self.call('searchJSON', t)
        AG.JS['goals'] = lambda t: self.call('goalsJSON', t)
        return self

    @staticmethod
    def uninstall():
        from . import agent as AG
        AG.JS['search'] = AG.JS['goals'] = None

    def close(self):
        self.uninstall()
        try:
            self.p.stdin.close()
            self.p.wait(5)
        except Exception:
            self.p.kill()

def words_for(name):
    w = WORDS.get(name)
    if w is None:
        raise KeyError(f'register entry {name!r} has no plain words (WORDS)')
    return w


def value(rules, src):
    if 'rules' in src:
        return getattr(rules, src['rules'])
    if 'const' in src:
        norm = lambda v: tuple(sorted(v)) if isinstance(v, (set, frozenset)) else v
